queries.succeededCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job WHERE status='SUCCEEDED';
queries.failedCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job WHERE status='FAILED';
queries.unfinishedCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING');
queries.retriedJobCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job WHERE attempt_count>1;
queries.missingMonsterCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job j LEFT JOIN queue_monster m ON m.monster_id=j.monster_id WHERE m.monster_id IS NULL;
queries.orphanMonsterCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue_monster m LEFT JOIN image_generation_job j ON j.monster_id=m.monster_id WHERE j.job_id IS NULL;
queries.misconnectedResultCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job j JOIN queue_monster m ON m.monster_id=j.monster_id WHERE m.prompt<>j.prompt OR m.image IS NULL OR m.image<>CONCAT('image:',j.prompt);
queries.unreleasedClaimCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job WHERE claim_token IS NOT NULL OR deadline_at IS NOT NULL;
queries.succeededWithoutImageCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_generation_job j JOIN queue_monster m ON m.monster_id=j.monster_id WHERE j.status='SUCCEEDED' AND (m.image IS NULL OR m.image='');
